text:
mira: Quick update — ran a basin sweep across RoPE variants (linear / NTK / YARN) on Mixtral, Qwen, Mistral and a few Llama checkpoints. Pasting profiler snippets + short summary. TL;DR: YARN reduces generation instability at long context for Mixtral/Qwen but introduces perplexity regressions on Llama past scale ~1.05; KV cache churn + dynamic batching is the main source of latency spikes.

mira: perf snapshot (median latency / p95 / PPL delta relative to baseline at scale=1.0 / GPU util):
```
model      variant   scale   median_ms  p95_ms  ppl_delta  gpu%
Mixtral-7  YARN      1.6     210        340     +0.6%      82
Mixtral-7  NTK       1.6     230        420     +1.9%      79
Qwen-7B    YARN      1.4     240        390     +0.9%      85
Qwen-7B    linear    1.4     215        360     +3.8%      88
Llama-65B  YARN      1.1     420        720     +7.2%      91
Llama-65B  linear    1.05    395        610     +1.3%      90
```
(Measurements on a 48GB GPU, batch tokens ~4k avg, fixed seq=16k runtime)

mira: Observations: 1) Mixtral tolerates aggressive YARN scaling, lower p95 jitter; 2) Qwen benefits on stability but shows slightly worse ppl at linear scaling — NTK more conservative but slower; 3) Llama exhibits steep quality cliff >1.05 (likely head/kv-dim mismatch when we scale rotary frequency).

mira: Profiling notes: continuous-batching + KV-cache rehydrate path shows repeated allocations on longctx for requests that mix short and long sequences. Hot funcs: `kv_copy_realloc`, `attn_kernel_dispatch`.

sanjay: Nice work. Which kernel variant used for these runs?

mira: kernel pinned to `attn-v2-quant-opt` for Mixtral/Qwen runs. Llama was on `attn-v1-compat` (we couldn't use v2 due to head_dim mismatch bug).

jong: On KV churn — I saw `kv_copy_realloc` spikes when dynamic batching packs a short request with a 16k request; cache resizing path does a memmove + zeroing. log excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-10 14:21:12] req=0x7f3c... size_change old_len=4096 new_len=16384 KV_REALLOC=1 time_us=4123
```
That 4ms/req shows up in p95 tail.

rachel: Can we re-run with `prefer-latency` batching heuristic (avoid packing short+long) and max_batch_tokens=8192 to see if tail drops? Also request full ppl eval on eval-set-v2 (n=500) at seq 4k/16k.

kevin: I recommend two mitigations: 1) short-term: switch Mixtral/Qwen to `attn-v2-quant-opt` + batching `prefer-latency` as rachel suggested; 2) mid-term: add a KV pre-allocate fast-path for mixed-length batches and a recycled buffer pool. We should also pin Llama to conservative NTK scaling <=1.05 until we fix head-rotation mapping.

mira: Agree. Quick safe ranges draft (from sweep):
- Mistral-7B: linear up to 1.3, NTK up to 1.25, YARN safe to 1.4 (good longctx)
- Mixtral-7B: YARN up to 1.8 safe, linear up to 1.5
- Qwen-7B: NTK preferred; linear >1.2 increases ppl. YARN helps stability up to 1.4 but watch ppl + mem
- Llama-65B: conservative NTK/linear cap at ~1.05; YARN causes visible perplexity cliffs >1.1

mira: Note these are per-checkpoint — we saw variance depending on head_kv_dim. If head_kv_dim != head_rot_dim scaling can break attention alignment. Need automated check in model onboarding that verifies head dims before suggesting any RoPE scaling >1.0.

jong: I'll add a CI check to validate head_kv_dim == head_rot_dim for suggested variants.

sanjay: I'll run the `prefer-latency` reruns tonight across 3 seeds and post results.

deploy-bot: deploy: rolled back `attn-v2.5` -> `attn-v2-compat` at 2026-03-10T15:02:11Z due to regression ticket #9432.

mira: Action items: 1) kevin/jong — prototype KV pre-alloc buffer pool + CI head-dims check; 2) sanjay/rachel — rerun prefer-latency + evalset n=500 for the 4k/16k splits; 3) infra: pin Llama endpoints to NTK scale <=1.05 until we confirm mapping fix. I'll upload the full CSV + profiler traces to the shared drive (link coming).

mira: pinging @sanjay @kevin for ETA on runs/patch. :thumbsup:
